meta: Plan weddings with AI: write a minute-by-minute run sheet, split the task list and send reminders so no small task is missed.

muc.title: Hundreds of small tasks
muc.text: A wedding has hundreds of small tasks; forget one and the couple is flustered all day.

muc.title: Minute by minute
muc.text: Give the guest arrival time, ceremony and performances, and ask a chatbot, an AI chat assistant, for a minute-by-minute run sheet.

muc.title: Who does what, when
muc.text: From the run sheet, ask AI for a task list: who's in charge, what time, what's needed.

muc.title: Reminders before each milestone
muc.text: Ask AI to draft reminders for the photographer, band and restaurant, sent three days and one day before.

muc.title: Ten often-forgotten tasks
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for ten tasks often forgotten on the wedding day, then tick off the ones not done yet.
